question: The festival 'BONALU' is celebrated in which of the following states in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Telangana__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Bonalu is a Telangana traditional Hindu festival centered on the Goddess Mahakali. 
 
• This festival is celebrated annually in the twin cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad, as well as in other parts of the state. 
 
• The festival is also considered a thanksgiving to the Goddess for the fulfillment of vows. 
 
• Other festivals of Telangana are: Bathukamma Festival, Sammakka Sarakka Jatara, Monthy Jataras, Ramzan.
